page.layout: One page of text, centred block below the running head; below it a centred signature line "Vv iij." and catchword-style "ORA-" at right; a woodcut ornament below. No margin notes.

main_text.p: catis & æterna damnatione eam redemisti, sed & Spiritum Sanctum tuum super eam effudisti, cuius virtute colligitur, docetur, regitur & in semita tendente ad cœlestem beatitudinem ducitur. Fac ut & nobis singulis hæc gratia tua sit salutaris. Conserva pios magistratus nutritios tuæ Ecclesiæ: defende scholas pietatis & honestatis seminaria: Reprime conatus hostium, ne turbent fidelium tuorum in his regionibus halcyoniam, ut tibi soli, uni & trino Deo Patri, Filio & Spiritui Sancto omnis laus & gloria in solidum tribuantur, & salus electorum tuorum magis magisque promoveatur,

page.notes: The first word of the page is a fragment ("catis", from "cœcatis"-type word split at the page start; printed as "catis"). The line "rita reddeipsorum consilia" reads "rita reddeipsorum consilia" in print with a catchword-like run-on; a line near "halcyonia:irrita" is printed as "halcyonia:irrita" with a hyphen-like mark, read here as "halcyoniam, irrita" on the scan. Some letters in the body are uncertain and should be checked against the scan. The woodcut ornament below the text is not transcribed.
